turns.text: Hello, this is an automated call from the Hillside research team. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time. May I speak with Mei?
Yes, this is Mei.
Thank you. I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Yes, now is a good time. Go ahead.

Thank you. I'll ask about some common symptoms. For each one, tell me the answer that fits best. In the past 7 days, how often have you had loose or watery bowel movements? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never, I haven't had any loose or watery bowel movements.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how often have you felt sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Rarely, just occasionally a little queasy, and it's mild.
In the past 7 days, how often have you thrown up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never, I haven't thrown up at all.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, have you had a fever, chills, or shaking?
No, I haven't had any fever, chills, or shaking.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how much shortness of breath have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
None, I haven't had any shortness of breath.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how much dizziness have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
None, I haven't had any dizziness.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how much tiredness or lack of energy have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
Mild, I've been a little tired, but resting makes it better.
Thank you. Does resting make the tiredness better?
Yes, resting does make it better.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, have you had a new skin rash?
No, I haven't had any new skin rash.
Thank you. Have you or your family noticed any new confusion, trouble finding words, or unusual sleepiness?
No, neither I nor my family have noticed any confusion, trouble finding words, or unusual sleepiness.
Thank you. Since your last study visit, have you started, stopped, or changed any medicines, including ones from the pharmacy or vitamins?
No, I haven't made any changes to my medicines.
Thank you. Since your last study visit, have you gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor?
No, I haven't gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or any other doctor.
Thank you. Is there anything else you would like the nurse to know?
No, there's nothing else I'd like to add.
Thank you, Mei. The research team will review your answers. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Goodbye.
